title: Explicit Finite-Sum Tail Risk Measures for Hierarchical Market--Credit Copula Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2610.08799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hierarchical copula models are widely used for aggregating market and credit risks across multi-level portfolio structures. Existing approaches often rely on Monte Carlo simulation, recursive sample reordering, or high-dimensional numerical procedures. This paper develops an analytical framework for hierarchical copula aggregation based on explicit finite-sum representations of aggregate loss distributions and tail-risk measures for two-level market-credit aggregation with Gaussian and mirrored Clayton copulas under empirical leaf-level marginals.   We derive deterministic formulas for aggregate distribution functions, quantiles, expected tail losses, and market-credit tail contributions, together with a compatibility condition linking local hierarchical copulas and global leaf-level dependence structures. translated_title: 层级市场-信用Copula聚合的显式有限和尾部风险度量
translated_abstract: 层级Copula模型被广泛应用于跨多级投资组合结构的市场风险与信用风险聚合。现有方法通常依赖于蒙特卡洛模拟、递归样本重排或高维数值计算程序。本文针对在经验叶级边际分布下、采用高斯Copula和镜像Clayton Copula的两级市场-信用聚合问题，基于聚合损失分布与尾部风险度量的显式有限和表示，构建了一个层级Copula聚合的解析框架。我们推导了聚合分布函数、分位数、期望尾部损失以及市场-信用尾部贡献的确定性公式，并给出了连接局部层级Copula与全局叶级依赖结构的相容性条件。分位数和期望尾部损失的估计误差表达式也以有限和形式获得。本文进一步分析……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于显式有限和表示的层级市场-信用Copula聚合解析框架，无需蒙特卡洛模拟即可确定性计算聚合分布、分位数、期望尾部损失及市场-信用尾部贡献，并给出连接局部与全局依赖结构的相容性条件。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an analytical framework for hierarchical market-credit copula aggregation based on explicit finite-sum representations, enabling deterministic computation of aggregate distributions, quantiles, expected tail losses, and tail contributions without Monte Carlo simulation, together with a compatibility condition linking local hierarchical copulas and global leaf-level dependence structures.
